title: Why are *Keywords* SO Important for your Resume?
description:
Why is so much resume advice around “keywords”? Keywords are critical because they are the language the company is looking for to prove you can do the job. A job description is where you’ll find them and writing your resume with the job and those keywords in mind is how you’ll start landing more interviews. #resume #resumetips #resumewriting
